registers.label: Spare
lines: A man ran up and knelt: Good Teacher, what must I do?
Jesus looked at him and loved him.
Go, sell what you have; then come, follow.
But his hands were full, and he went away grieving.
Who then can be saved?
For mortals it is impossible, but not for God.
Come, let us worship with open hands.
With God, all things are possible. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: A man came running and fell on his knees: Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life? And Jesus, looking at him, loved him.
With God, all things are possible.
One thing you lack, he said: go, sell what you have, give it away, and you will have treasure in heaven. And the man's face fell, for he had much.
With God, all things are possible.
How hard it is to loosen our grip, to let our hands fall open, to seek good and not evil and live.
With God, all things are possible.
So come to the throne of grace and find mercy. Lay your burden down and worship.
With God, all things are possible. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A rich man knelt and asked the way to life.
All things are possible with God.
Sell what you have, and come, follow me.
All things are possible with God.
Who then can be saved? For God, nothing is impossible.
All things are possible with God.
Come to the throne of grace and worship.
All things are possible with God. Amen.
